fix: All generated Wrangler shell fixtures now run through /bin/bash in dispatch_case and unset_local_regression. The production harness has a test-only AU18_TEST_SHELL_WRANGLER switch; its default execution path is unchanged.

tests.detail: The direct fixture exec hang no longer occurs. The run advances through the mocked cases, then reports existing mock payload/schema failures (jq parse error and top-level container version absent) before timeout under the concurrently loaded local runner.
